title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: The Spyglass tool has officially launched, moving from beta to provide all users with its full range of powerful features.

title: Empowering File Control in the Editor
summary: This new feature gives you complete control over your files within the editor, allowing for easy uploading, downloading, and personalized display options to perfectly showcase your content.

title: Our New Product Roadmap is Live!
summary: Discover our new product roadmap, providing a clear overview of recently completed features, upcoming developments, and exciting plans on the horizon.

title: Enhanced Interactive Checkboxes
summary: Experience a more fluid and efficient workflow with our newly redesigned checkboxes, now easier to click, fully draggable, and beautifully integrated into your workspace.

title: Seamless Team Collaboration
summary: Experience effortless teamwork with improved real-time updates and clearer indicators that keep everyone perfectly in sync.

title: Seamless Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and collaborate on shared items with friends, making teamwork smoother and more intuitive.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: We're opening Noeko's codebase to empower you with maximum control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in the project's exciting future.

title: Global Language Expansion
summary: We're thrilled to introduce robust support for multiple international languages, allowing users worldwide to experience Noeko in their native tongue.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Get ready to personalize your experience with a stunning collection of vibrant new themes and beautifully refined classics, designed to bring fresh style and clarity to your workspace.

title: Enhanced Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your knowledge base with new filtering and sharing options in the enhanced Constellation view, making it a powerful tool for discovery and collaboration.

title: Advanced Search & Personalized Compendiums
summary: Experience a powerful new way to find and organize your information with advanced search filters, custom sorting, and the ability to save your precise results into personalized Compendiums.

title: Smarter Linked Notes
summary: Get a clearer, more interactive view of your linked content directly within your notes, transforming how you structure and engage with your ideas.

title: Unlock Noeko Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience enhanced flexibility and control with Noeko's upcoming self-hosting options and a range of new paid plans designed to fit your unique requirements.

title: Smart Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're enhancing our application's greetings to always reflect the precise time of day, ensuring a delightful and accurate welcome every time you log in.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items with new quick actions directly within any tag view, allowing you to remove, delete, or explore them without tedious navigation.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
